title: Founder Runtime DB CRUD Workflow Wiring
globalSafetyRules: Implement one subphase at a time.
Do not modify projects/**, careloop/**, generated app Sources/Tests, providers/**, tools/**, worker-runtime/**, deploy/**, release/**, exports/**, packages/**, or .env*.
P94.1 is contract-only and must not modify db/**, dashboard source, live runtime models, or local-state runtime data.
Later P94 subphases may only add governed local SQLite CRUD for NEXUS OS founder workflow records where explicitly scoped.

Do not enable provider/model calls, agent dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, project creation, project mutation, hosted DBs, network calls, deploy, release, export, package creation, or provider spend.
Do not expose DemoApp in full Command Center.
Do not show project/private raw IDs in primary UX.
Do not invent fake working actions.

subphases.objective: Define the founder runtime DB CRUD workflow wiring contract before schema, runtime, or UX changes.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.futureDataShape: Result envelope with schemaVersion, currentState, runtimeMode, dbMode, founderSession, qnaTurns[], prdArtifact, workstreamPlan, activationReview, runtimeTasks[], evidenceRefs[], auditRefs[], activityRefs[], allowedLocalCrudOperations[], forbiddenOperations[], mutationGate, runtimeFlags, nextAction, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, activityLocation, costImpact, commandCenterVisible, and all non-scoped unsafe runtime flags false.

subphases.commandCenterUxRequirements: Preserve current Command Center UX. Later P94 UX must make Lite and Business Build useful for founder-to-business flow by showing saved founder session state, next question, PRD readiness, workstream lanes, current DB state, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner capability, evidence/activity location, and cost impact without raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, DemoApp, raw private IDs, or fake runnable actions.
playwrightTests: No Playwright update in P94.1 because no UI files change.
P94 Command Center UX subphase must add focused Lite, Business Build, and DB Runtime route coverage.
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm no db/**, dashboard/src/**, dashboard/tests/**, live-ready/**, or local-state/runtime/** files changed.
Confirm no provider/model calls, agent dispatch, tool/worker execution, project creation, project mutation, hosted DB, network, deploy, release, export, package, or spend is enabled.
